## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or brief and list integration limitations.

## Validation

Record the real commands and outputs, including failures and skipped checks. Link the report and screenshots for UI changes.

## Review

- [ ] Scope matches the brief and approved prototype.
- [ ] Shared tokens and business logic are reused.
- [ ] Identity and owner isolation are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, account data or environment files are included.
- [ ] Keyboard, phone and reduced-motion behavior were checked when relevant.
